red_flags: Eye pain, redness, visual change, or inability to protect the cornea
New limb weakness, speech disturbance, severe headache, or other central neurologic symptoms

must_ask.say: When did you first notice the facial weakness after your parotid surgery?
Can you close your eye fully, and does it feel dry or irritated?
Which parts of your face feel weak — forehead, eye, mouth, or all of them?

must_ask.objective: Functional impact on eating and speech
must_ask.say: Do you have trouble eating, drinking, or speaking clearly because of the weakness?
How has this affected your confidence, and what are you hoping surgery can restore?
